import urllib.request
import json

def get_ncbi_gene_summary(gene_id):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode())

def search_gene(symbol, organism="Homo sapiens"):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={symbol}[Gene+Name]+AND+{organism}[Organism]&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode())

for sym in ["ACOT7", "PTRH2"]:
    res = search_gene(sym)
    gene_id = res["esearchresult"]["idlist"][0]
    summ = get_ncbi_gene_summary(gene_id)["result"][gene_id]
    print(sym, "Gene ID:", gene_id, "Description:", summ["description"])
    genomic_info = summ.get("genomicinfo", [])
    if genomic_info:
        g = genomic_info[0]
        length = abs(g["chrstop"] - g["chrstart"]) + 1
        print(f"  Genomic span: {length} bp (Chr {g['chrloc']}: {g['chrstart']}-{g['chrstop']})")
